hypothesis: Binding the frozen v25 lifecycle diagnostic to each exact HIP-3 provider-symbol scorecard entry will prevent the checkpoint and TUI from presenting obsolete source-lifecycle claims while preserving the distinction between isolated bar-diagnostic positives and portfolio-level stress robustness.
decision: Supersede revision 8 only to record the report-only cockpit evidence update. All ten active HIP-3 provider-symbol mappings now cite the v25 fixed-80-bps and 24-hour lifecycle diagnostic. Three isolated symbol-provider mappings are labeled positive but unrouted; seven are labeled stress-negative; no aggregate provider route is represented as stress-positive. Keep the active v25 execution profile, routing, sizing, positions, and orders unchanged. The monitor launcher will refresh this evidence through its execution-incapable checkpoint sidecar; this revision grants no promotion or execution authority.
falsifier: The telemetry-wiring claim is falsified if a checkpoint generated by the current source does not bind all ten active HIP-3 mappings to the cited diagnostic and exact per-symbol state. The economic assessment remains provisional and is updated only by combined-priority shared-account wall-clock replay or reconciled live v25 lifecycles; isolated positive bar results do not falsify the route-level stress conclusion.
limitations: The TUI evidence update improves attribution and operator visibility; it does not improve the strategy's economic performance by itself.
Positive-unrouted means one provider-symbol bar approximation remained positive under the modeled stress case; it does not establish combined routing or live edge.
The diagnostic remains an independent-asset 15-minute approximation and omits shared-account routing, exact wall-clock timing, and complete venue microstructure parity.
The running Python execution backend retains its already-loaded v25 code and was not restarted or hot-mutated.
The monitor sidecar is execution-incapable and can only read ledgers, query portfolio state, synchronize research records, and publish telemetry.
Fresh reconciled canary closes remain necessary before any sizing, route, or lifecycle change is justified.
